description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing 'Information' entities within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class includes methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and deleting informational entries, handling related permissions, SEO URLs, and localization aspects.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing information entries including listing, editing, adding, deleting, enabling, and disabling information data in OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main information management page with filters, breadcrumbs, and related data, and renders the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of information entries by delegating to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares a paginated list of information entries based on filters, sorting, and pagination parameters, returning a view template.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the add/edit form, including information data, language options, stores, SEO URLs, layouts, and loads the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving an information entry, including validation for permissions, input lengths, and SEO URLs, then adds or updates the record.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected information entries by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected information entries by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected information entries after permission and dependency checks.
